## 1. User Story Reference

| Field | Value |

| **Title** | Get Vehicle Details |
| **As a** | car shopper |

| **So that** | I can view specifications and pricing |

**Business Objective:** Enable users to fetch complete vehicle information by vehicle ID.

## 2. Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Source |
|----|-------------|--------|
| FR-001 | The system shall retrieve vehicle details by a given vehicle ID from the database, returning all vehicle attributes (make, model, year, price, transmission, fuel_type). | `userstory.md` — Functional Requirements |

## 3. Acceptance Criteria

| ID | Criterion | Traces To |
|----|-----------|-----------|
| AC-001 | Given a valid vehicle ID, when a request is made to retrieve vehicle details, then the response contains all vehicle attributes: make, model, year, price, transmission, and fuel_type. | FR-001 |

## 5. Out of Scope

The following are explicitly excluded from this user story:

- Vehicle search or filtering by attributes
- Vehicle creation, update, or deletion
- User authentication or authorization
- Non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, availability)
- Integration with external data providers
- Recommendation engine logic
